full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration shows an eccentric modernist building from a low, slightly oblique front viewpoint. The structure is assembled from overlapping rectangular volumes in chalk white, saturated teal, mustard yellow, and warm orange-red. A teal central wall forms the broadest field. On its left, a bold orange exterior stair climbs in two angled runs, crossing in front of yellow and white wall planes. At the upper center, a long white horizontal balcony projects outward with a red-orange parapet and thin dark metal railing. A yellow block at the right projects toward the viewer, its front face pierced by a small dark window. Narrow doors and windows in dark brown frames puncture the colored walls without establishing regular symmetry. A second shorter stair climbs through the middle from right to left, creating a zigzag of light and shadow. Flat roof slabs, railings, and shallow ledges cast hard-edged shadows under clear sun. The building stands against a smooth turquoise sky, which amplifies the warm-cool color opposition. Its surfaces have a lightly weathered painted texture rather than glassy digital perfection. The image is cropped close, so the building occupies almost all of the frame and the stacked geometry reads as an interlocked composition. A pale paved platform and low steps run along the bottom edge. There are no people, vehicles, signs, or readable text. The mood is inventive, optimistic, and theatrical, with functionally recognizable building parts reorganized into a lively arrangement of planes, diagonals, and projecting boxes.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑插画从稍低、略斜的正面角度呈现一栋奇异的现代主义建筑。结构由粉笔白、饱和青绿、芥末黄和暖橙红的矩形体块相互叠合。中央青绿墙面形成最宽色域。左侧一道醒目的橙色外梯分两段斜向上升，从黄白墙面前方穿过。上方中央一块长白色水平阳台向外伸出，带红橙色栏板和细黑金属栏杆。右侧一块黄色体量朝观者凸出，正面开着一扇小暗窗。深棕边框的窄门与窗点缀彩色墙，却不构成规整对称。第二道较短阶梯从右向左穿过中部，形成明暗锯齿。平屋顶板、栏杆和浅檐在晴日下投出硬边影。建筑立在平滑青绿色天空前，增强冷暖色对置。表面有轻微风化的涂漆纹理，不像完美光滑的数码物体。画面紧裁，建筑几乎占满全幅，叠加几何呈相扣的构成。底边有浅色铺装平台及矮阶。没有人物、车辆、标识或可读文字。氛围充满发明感、乐观且有舞台性，可辨认的建筑部件被重组为活泼的平面、斜线与凸出方盒。
style_prompt_en: Build the image from interlocking rectilinear volumes, assertive horizontal slabs, zigzag diagonals, and a few thin linear railings. Favor a limited high-contrast palette of teal, chalk white, mustard yellow, and orange-red against a clean cool field. Use flat painted surfaces with a touch of weathering, crisp silhouettes, and hard-edged sunlight that cuts graphic shadow shapes below projections. Keep the viewpoint low enough to give the stacked masses presence, but preserve clear legibility of every crossing plane. Arrange colors as distinct structural blocks rather than blended gradients. The visual energy comes from asymmetry, overlap, cantilevers, and rhythmic changes in scale, producing a playful yet disciplined geometric composition.
style_prompt_zh: 以相扣的直线体块、鲜明水平板、锯齿斜线和少量细栏杆线建立图像。选用青绿、粉笔白、芥末黄与橙红组成有限而高对比的色板，置于洁净冷色场前。表面呈平整涂漆并略有风化，轮廓清晰，硬边日光在外挑部位下切出图形化影形。视点足够低，让层叠体量有存在感，同时保持每处交叉平面可读。颜色按鲜明结构色块组织，不混成渐变。视觉能量来自不对称、重叠、悬挑和尺度的节奏变化，形成活泼却有纪律的几何构成。
theme_en: A colorful Constructivist building of stacked blocks, ramps, and balconies
theme_zh: 由叠置体块、坡梯和阳台组成的彩色构成主义建筑
name: Constructivist architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
